proof.text: Apply affine-base gluing [lem-galois-fpqc-effectivity-affine-base-gluing]. For its local hypothesis, choose the finite affine refinement [lem-galois-fpqc-singleton-affine-refinement]. The chosen categorical pullback carries a datum by [lem-galois-fpqc-canonical-pullback-datum]. Base-change stability of P and the assumed affine effectiveness give an effective datum over the refinement. Apply [lem-galois-fpqc-refinement-reflects-effectivity] to conclude effectiveness over the original affine-base cover.

split_report.summary: Split the fpqc one-member reduction along Stacks Lemma 02W3. The proof restricts to affine opens, replaces each affine singleton cover by a finite coproduct of affine opens (Topologies 022E), applies the stated affine effectiveness hypothesis, descends the resulting isomorphism through the refinement using 02W0, and glues the local descents over affine opens using Constructions 01LH. Two unsplit supporting nodes record the finite affine refinement and the specialized refinement full-faithfulness statement; existing nodes supply fpqc base change, singleton morphism descent, relative gluing, and morphism gluing.
split_report.blueprint: The steps realize the parent lem-galois-descent proof Step 2 effectivity replacement: affine reduction and finite refinement correspond to the 02W3 reduction, refinement full faithfulness to 02W0, and the final affine-open gluing to 01LH. The statement remains the one-member fpqc specialization recorded in the item.

lean.statement: theorem fpqcDescentEffective_of_affine (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (hbase : ∀ {Y V V' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ V) (h : V' ⟶ V), P g → P (pullback.snd g h)) (hcoprod : ∀ (m : ℕ) (Y V : Fin m → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ V i), (∀ i, P (g i)) → P (Limits.Sigma.map g)) (haffine : ∀ {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S] (f : X ⟶ S), Flat f → Surjective f → ∀ {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V), P V.hom → D.IsEffective) {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (hfpqc : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S) {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V) (hV : P V.hom) : D.IsEffective
